passages.text: A carrier includes the relevant topology, pairing and operator domains, not merely an underlying set or vector space. passages.text: In explicit separable carriers, countable infinity can enter through a named index set and canonical completion without any selection from an arbitrary family. The finite-to-infinite boundary still adds real mathematical content: summability, completion, operator domains, and limits. It simply need not add Countable Choice in the same step. ``Infinite'' and ``choice-dependent'' are not synonyms.
